# Road Paving Insurance

> Road Paving Insurance (by Contractors Choice Agency) provides commercial insurance for this trade in all 50 states. Coverage lines: Commercial General Liability for road paving contractors, Workers' Compensation for road paving contractors, Commercial Auto & Trucking for road paving contractors, Contractor's Equipment Insurance for road paving contractors, Inland Marine Coverage for road paving contractors, Umbrella & Excess Liability for road paving contractors, Surety Bonds for road paving contractors, Builder's Risk Insurance for road paving contractors. A-rated carriers. Licensed in all 50 states — NPN #8608479. Founded 2005. Contact: 844-967-5247, josh@contractorschoiceagency.com.
